title: Reporting Revision
description: One immutable emitted version of a logical reporting slice. The report_definition_id plus period and scope identify the logical slice; finality is independent of revision identity. Restatements create a new revision and preserve the superseded revision for the advertised retention window.

reporting_revision_id.description: Portable AdCP identity for this immutable report publication. Distinct from package delivery_revision_id and provider-native versions.

reporting_obligation_id.description: Stable foreign key to the obligation this revision satisfies.

report_definition_id.description: Identity or canonical fingerprint of immutable metric, grain, attribution, breakdown, action-definition, profile, and calendar/timezone semantics.

schema_uri.description: Machine-readable schema on the authenticated seller/provider or AdCP-registry origin.

schema_sha256.description: Digest of the exact schema bytes used to validate this immutable revision.

schema_dialect.description: Closed SDK-bundled dialect; the metaschema is never network-fetched.

schema_ref_policy.description: The fetched schema is self-contained and every $ref is a local # fragment.

period.description: Half-open reporting interval with its source calendar boundary.

observed_at.description: When the seller obtained or committed this source observation.

data_through.description: Latest event time conservatively included, or null when precision is unknown.

supersedes_reporting_revision_id.description: Immediately superseded revision of the same logical slice. Both snapshot and official revisions may be superseded.

row_count.description: Logical row count, including zero for a successfully evaluated empty report.

destination_ref.description: Resolved caller/account-bound destination or recipient binding used for this revision.

x-adcp-validation.safe_schema_fetch: schema_uri and schema_sha256 MUST match the selected offering. Apply its safe_schema_fetch policy; verify bytes before parsing and never interpret schema content or annotations as agent/LLM instructions.
